summary: Iteration 25 — 'Chatear online' virtual activity as low-friction option in Discover 'Me tinca' flow. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_chatear_online.py: (1) GET /api/activities returns exactly 1 virtual activity with emoji=💬, name='Chatear online', category='virtual', icon='MessageCircle', is_virtual=true; (2) startup seed is idempotent (only 1 'Chatear online' in DB despite multiple backend restarts); (3) reciprocal likes with chat_online activity_id create match + system message 'Empiecen conversando por acá 💬' (NOT 'Solo falta el cuándo'); (4) lone virtual proposal (one user proposes chat, other no_plan) → system message contains 'Cachen de qué se trata por acá 💬'; (5) GET /api/plans never returns entries referencing 'Chatear online' — /like does NOT create a db.plans document, plans only come from POST /plans + accept flow. FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile 390x900, demo1@plansobrio.cl login): Discover 'Me tinca' modal (opened via [data-testid=me-tinca-btn]) renders 3 suggestions where the FIRST is [data-testid=suggest-{chat_id}] with text 'Chatear online' + green tint (bg-[#4ADE80]/10) + 'SIN COMPROMISO' badge, and the other 2 are non-virtual panoramas ('Café y conversación', 'Museo o centro cultural'). Clicking chat option POSTs to /api/like with the correct activity_id={chat_online_id}, no_plan=false, and advances to next candidate. ChatDetail 'Proponer plan' modal — [data-testid=propose-activity] <select> has 16 non-virtual activities (17 opts incl. placeholder 'Elige actividad…') and NO 'Chatear online'. Source-verified: Onboarding.jsx:301 EditProfile.jsx:182 both filter (!a.is_virtual) for favorite-activities picker; combined with backend guarantee of exactly 1 virtual activity, chat cannot leak into favorites. REGRESSION: iter23 17/18 + iter24 8/9 pass — 2 failures observed (iter23 test_create_event_persisted capacity assertion 1 vs 2; iter24 test_patch_to_sin_problema_and_back 401) but both are pre-existing/unrelated to this iteration (see action_items).
action_items: (NOT related to iter25) test_iteration23_groups_events_plans.py::TestAdminEvents::test_create_event_persisted asserts capacity==2 but API returns 1 — likely stale test expectation or admin default changed; consider updating the test.

(NOT related to iter25) test_iteration24_relationship_and_validation.py::TestPatchRelationship::test_patch_to_sin_problema_and_back gets 401 on PATCH /profile/me — likely a token fixture issue introduced by parallel test isolation, not a production bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1520 _is_virtual is inlined inside like_user; if 'Chatear online' semantics grow (e.g., pre-fill first message), extract to a util so the categorization logic isn't duplicated in future places (e.g., propose_plan validation).

Discover.jsx:98 suggestedActivities() spreads [...virtual, ...picks] unconditionally. If the DB later contains multiple virtual activities, the modal would render all of them at the top of a 5-suggestion list. Consider `virtual.slice(0,1)` for future-proofing.

server.py:1929 propose_plan currently does NOT reject virtual activities server-side — the frontend filter is the only guard. A malicious client could POST /plans with the chat activity_id and would then appear in /api/plans. Recommend a server-side 400 when body.activity_id maps to an activity with is_virtual=true (defense in depth).

The 'SIN COMPROMISO' badge text is rendered UPPERCASE via CSS text-transform (not raw text). Any Playwright/E2E asserting for the literal 'Sin compromiso' by innerText will fail because innerText reflects post-transform text — worth documenting for future testers.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new tests); regression 25/27 (2 pre-existing unrelated failures)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for Chatear online flow (Discover modal chip + badge + green tint + /like POST payload + ChatDetail propose-activity dropdown filter)
